title: Person
description: A canonical historical/literary person entity. Aliases are recorded but never merged with a different real person sharing a similar name.

person_id.description: Stable canonical ID, e.g. person.zhou_yu. Never reused for a different individual.

canonical_name_ko.description: Korean display name; null until UI localization is defined (S2).

type.description: e.g. courtesy_name(字), posthumous_name(諡), nickname, honorific, title

observed_in.description: Only source layers where this alias was actually confirmed present in extracted text; never inferred.

alias_collision_note.description: If this alias string is shared with a different canonical person, explain the disambiguation rule here. Never silently merge.
